info.name: FitLife — Review full API + bug reproductions
info.description: Run with npm run test:postman:review. Disposable MongoDB only; the runner supplies trainer/admin/other-user fixtures. The REGRESSION requests assert desired behavior and intentionally expose unresolved bugs. No live AI or Atlas calls.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 429) { pm.test('Rate limited: wait Retry-After=' + pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After') + ' seconds before rerunning', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); }

pm.test("Route catalog contains all business groups", () => { const e=pm.response.json().endpoints; ['auth','profile','water','workouts','exercises','meals','quests'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(e).to.have.property(k)); });
pm.test("04 — Register isolated user — HTTP 201", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test("New account has user role, zero coins and valid token", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql('user'); pm.expect(b.user.profile.coins).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.token).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/); });

pm.test("Session expiry is positive and no longer than 12h", () => { const remaining=Date.parse(pm.response.json().expires_at)-Date.now(); pm.expect(remaining).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(remaining).to.be.at.most(43200000); });
pm.test("06 — Login fresh session — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("07 — Reject missing bearer — HTTP 401", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test("Profile is private and birthday is initially unknown", () => { const p=pm.response.json().profile; pm.expect(p.user_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('fitlifeUserId')); pm.expect(p.date_of_birth).to.eql(null); pm.expect(p).not.to.have.property('password_hash'); });
pm.test("10 — Patch name, birthday and email — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("Birthday and email persisted", () => { const p=pm.response.json().profile; pm.expect(p.full_name).to.eql('Hồ sơ đã cập nhật'); pm.expect(p.date_of_birth).to.eql('2000-05-15'); pm.expect(p.email).to.eql(pm.variables.get('fitlifeEmail')); pm.expect(p.age).to.be.within(5,100); });
pm.test("11 — Invalid calendar date — HTTP 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("12 — Reject profile privilege injection — HTTP 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("Water grants exactly 10 coins", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(10); pm.expect(b.fit_coins).to.eql(10); });
pm.test("No duplicate water reward", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Water total is 250ml", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.logs).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(250); });

pm.test("Workout reward and daily water bonus", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(10); pm.expect(b.fit_coins).to.eql(20); pm.expect(b.target_water).to.eql(2625); });
pm.test("Workout is not duplicated", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(0); });

pm.test("Workout totals match", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.logs).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.total_duration_seconds).to.eql(600); pm.expect(b.total_calories_burned).to.eql(50); });
pm.test("19 — Invalid workout date — HTTP 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("Meal reward increases total to 30", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(10); pm.expect(b.fit_coins).to.eql(30); });

pm.test("Nutrition totals reflect the isolated meal", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.logs).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.total_calories).to.eql(450); pm.expect(b.total_protein).to.eql(25); });
pm.test("23 — Partial meal patch — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Partial PATCH preserves omitted fields", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meal.calories).to.eql(600); pm.expect(b.meal.meal_name).to.eql('Phở bò'); });
pm.test("24 — Confirm meal quest — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("Only water, workout and meal quests are complete", () => { const qs=pm.response.json().quests; pm.expect(qs).to.have.lengthOf(7); pm.expect(qs.filter(q=>q.is_completed).map(q=>q.quest_key).sort()).to.eql(['q_meal','q_water','q_workout']); });
pm.test("Deleted meal no longer contributes calories", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.logs).to.have.lengthOf(0); pm.expect(b.total_calories).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("27 — Verify refund balance — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Only meal reward was withdrawn", () => { const p=pm.response.json().profile; pm.expect(p.fit_coins).to.eql(20); pm.expect(p.target_water).to.eql(2625); });
pm.test("28 — Verify quest reset — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Meal quest reset after last meal deletion", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().quests.find(q=>q.quest_key==='q_meal').is_completed).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("29 — Exercise list first page — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("Exercise catalog is populated and localized", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(b.data[0].display_name).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.data[0].gif_url.startsWith('https://')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.meta.hasNextPage).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("30 — Exercise next page — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("Cursor does not repeat exercises", () => { const previous=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('fitlifeFirstIds')); pm.response.json().data.forEach(x=>pm.expect(previous).not.to.include(x.exercise_id)); });
pm.test("31 — Exercise detail by internal UUID — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("32 — Invalid exercise identifier — HTTP 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("Sleep upsert keeps ID without reward", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.log.sleep_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('reviewSleepId')); });

pm.test("Stats aggregate actual logs", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.days).to.have.lengthOf(7); pm.expect(b.days.at(-1).water_ml).to.eql(250); pm.expect(b.days.at(-1).sleep_hours).to.eql(8); });
pm.test("Rules reply and q_chat reward", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reply.ai_engine).to.eql('fitlife-rules'); pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.eql(10); });
pm.test("Chat cross-user read denied HTTP 404", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test("Chat cross-user write denied HTTP 404", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: REGRESSION chat retry must recover reply

exec: pm.test("REGRESSION chat retry must recover reply HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Retry returns the stored reply after a lost response", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.reply).to.be.an("object"); });

item.name: REGRESSION no same-day repeat challenge reward

exec: pm.test("REGRESSION no same-day repeat challenge reward HTTP 409", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test("Purchase retry does not debit twice", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.fit_coins).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('reviewAfterPurchaseCoins'))); });
pm.test("Duplicate badge purchase denied HTTP 409", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test("REGRESSION ownership beyond 100 purchases HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Old owned theme remains owned after 101 voucher purchases", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.find(i=>i.item_id===pm.variables.get('reviewOldThemeId')).owned).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Trainer denied unrelated student HTTP 403", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test("Trainer reads linked student health HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Other member cannot complete assignment HTTP 404", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: Trainer health access closes after completion

exec: pm.test("Trainer health access closes after completion HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Health is hidden without open work", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().health).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Member ends trainer link HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Trainer creates invite to cancel HTTP 201", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test("Admin locks other account HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Admin unlocks other account HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Revoked token stays invalid after unlock

exec: pm.test("Revoked token stays invalid after unlock HTTP 401", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("33 — Logout registration session — HTTP 204", () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test("34 — Revoked registration token — HTTP 401", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("35 — Login session remains active — HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("36 — Logout remaining session — HTTP 204", () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test("37 — Session revoked immediately — HTTP 401", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
